Clodsire

Poison Ground

Paldea · Generation 9

Clodsire is a Poison/Ground-type Spiny Fish Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 1.8 m tall and weighs 223 kg. It evolves from Wooper. Its highest base stat is HP (130), with a base stat total of 430.
